en.headline: Tram services suspended between Admiralty and Johnston Road after power fault
en.dek: Both eastbound and westbound services on the section were halted from about 9.40pm; the Transport Department advised passengers to use alternative routes.
body: Hong Kong Tramways suspended services between Admiralty MTR Station and Johnston Road in both directions on Tuesday evening because of a power supply fault.

The Transport Department said it received notification from the tram company at about 9.43pm. Engineers were working to restore the electricity supply on the affected section, which serves part of the Central and Wan Chai corridors.
Passengers were advised to allow extra travelling time and to use alternative public transport. There was no immediate indication of when full service would resume.

zh.headline: 金鐘至杜老誌道電車因電力故障暫停服務
zh.dek: 運輸署晚上約9時43分接獲通知，東西行線電車均暫停；工程人員正搶修，乘客需改用其他交通工具。
body: 香港電車因電力故障，周二晚暫停金鐘港鐵站至杜老誌道之間的東西行線服務。
運輸署表示，晚上約9時43分接獲電車公司通知。受影響路段覆蓋中環至灣仔部分走廊，工程人員正進行搶修以恢復電力供應。
署方呼籲乘客預留額外時間，並改用其他公共交通工具。暫未有全面恢復服務的時間表。
